title: AuthFoam

listing.shortDescription: A complete authentication starter — React client with sign-up, login and protected pages, backed by an Express and MySQL API.
listing.fullDescription: AuthFoam is a full-stack authentication system that any product can grow from. The React client provides a reusable auth form, sign-up, login and protected home, about and contact pages, wired to an Express API with a MySQL store. It is the unglamorous foundation every app needs, built properly once.

closing.conclusion: AuthFoam delivered a complete, reusable authentication stack — sign-up, login and protected pages wired end to end — ready to be the starting point for any product that needs accounts.

challenge.summary: Every product needs accounts, and most auth codebases are copy-paste chaos. AuthFoam set out to be the clean, reusable foundation — one repo with client and server working together.
